title: Nutty Jamaican Chicken Curry
description: A citrusy and comforting Jamaican dish featuring nuts and tandoor spices, made with macrobiotic-friendly ingredients. This recipe combines the warmth of curry with the crunch of nuts for a unique flavor experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, grind the chopped almonds into a coarse powder.
In a large bowl, whisk together the tandoor spice mix, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken pieces to the skillet and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the diced tomatoes and coconut milk.
Simmer the curry over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
